transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...I guess I'm here because I need someone to actually listen. For over a year now, I've been trying to get someone to take my situation seriously. 

At work... they've been using the new ticket rotation and the security audits to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs, telling me it's just policy, but... I know what it is. That's... basically why I'm here.
Do you think others at work believe the same thing about the ticket rotation and security audits as you do?

...I couldn't really say. I don't ask them. 

We all just... do our own work. It's usually better to keep your head down anyway. So, no, I don't know what they believe.
Do you think it's possible that the ticket rotation and security audits are actually just policy and not being used against you?

...No. I don't. 

I know management says that. They sit there, they show me the logs, and they tell me it's just standard policy. But... it's been over a year of this now. I've been in this field a long time. I know exactly what it looks like when a paper trail is being built against someone. 

So... no. I don't think it's just policy.
Have you ever considered that you might be mistaken about the intentions of your management?

...No. I haven't. 

I mean... I already told you. It's been over a year. I've seen the logs they keep showing me, I hear them say it's policy, but... I know what they're doing. They're building a paper trail. I'm not mistaken about that.
Has your belief that management is building a paper trail against you ever changed or wavered since you first started thinking it?

...No. It hasn't. 

I've been dealing with this for over a year now. The new ticket rotation, the security audits... I'm just trying to get someone to actually take it seriously. Management keeps showing me their logs and telling me it's just policy, but... I know they're building a paper trail against me. 

So, no. My mind hasn't changed.
Have you ever had any other beliefs like this one that you held strongly but later found out were not true?

...No. 

I don't think so. I... I know what I see. I've never been one to just make things up. If that's what you're asking.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you felt were absolutely true, like the one about management building a paper trail against you?

...No. 

I just told you. I don't... I don't make things up. I just know what's happening at my job. That's all.
Have you changed your behavior at work because of your belief that management is building a paper trail against you?

...I suppose I've had to. 

I mean, I don't volunteer for the bigger network projects anymore. It's just... too risky. And when I do close out a ticket, I make sure my notes are... thorough. Very detailed. Just to cover myself. 

It takes longer. Some of the younger guys on the team get annoyed, and... the meetings are a bit quiet lately when I'm there. But I have to protect myself.
Has your belief that management is building a paper trail against you affected your life outside of work?

...Not really. 

I mean, the stuff at work is... it's just at work. The ticket rotation, the audits... that's where the problem is. Outside of that, things are fine. I still keep the house in order, pay the bills. I help my wife with what she needs. 

And even at work, the technical part of my job is fine. Nobody can say my work is sloppy or disorganized. I just do what I need to do.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with your wife or friends since you started believing management is building a case against you?

...No. Not really. 

Like I said, the work stuff stays at work. My wife and I... we're fine. We just do our normal routine. And friends... I don't know, I guess I see them about the same amount as always. Nothing's really changed there.

Is your belief that management is building a paper trail against you something that you think might be connected to other things happening in your life or the world, or is it mostly just about what's going on at work?

...It's just work. 

I mean, why would it be about anything else? The audits, the way they track my tickets... that's all happening at the office. It doesn't have anything to do with the rest of the world. It's just management trying to push me out. That's all it is.
Has there ever been a moment, no matter how brief, where you doubted your belief that management is building a paper trail against you?

...No. 

I mean... they keep showing me the logs. Management. They pull up these reports and tell me it's just standard policy, that everyone is getting audited the same way. 

But... no. I know what I see. I've been trying for over a year to get someone to actually look at it, to take it seriously. The way the ticket rotation works now, the specific security audits... they're building a paper trail. I don't doubt that. They can say it's policy all they want.
Has your belief about management building a paper trail against you affected your sleep?

...Sleep? 

No. I sleep fine. It doesn't really affect that. I just... I go to bed, I wake up. It's normal.
Do you think the belief that management is building a paper trail against you is something that could happen to anyone, or is it something unusual or unique to you?

...I suppose it could happen to anyone. 

If they wanted someone gone, they'd do it to them, too. But right now... they're doing it to me. So it's happening to me. That's all.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you felt were absolutely true, but that others did not believe?

...No. 

Just this. I don't... I don't have other things like that. Just what's actually happening at work.
Is your belief about management building a paper trail against you part of a larger plan or conspiracy that you think is happening?

...No. I don't know anything about a conspiracy. 

It's just... it's just what's happening at my office. They want me gone. There's no grand plan or anything like that. Just the paper trail. That's the whole thing.
Do you think there's any way to prove or disprove that management is building a paper trail against you?

...I mean, the proof is right there. That's... that's why I'm here. 

For over a year now, I've been trying to get someone, anyone, to take this seriously. The new ticket rotation... the security audits. It's obvious they're using them to build this paper trail. Management keeps... they keep pulling up these logs and telling me it's just standard policy. But... I know what it is. I just need someone to actually look at it and see what's happening.
Are you experiencing significant stress or anxiety because of your belief that management is building a paper trail against you?

...Yes. It's stressful. 

I just... I have to be careful now. At work. I've been avoiding some of the network projects. And... I have to write really long notes in my tickets, just to defend myself. Cover everything. It makes the meetings tense. I guess it slows things down with the team, but... I don't have a choice.
Has your belief that management is building a paper trail against you changed in any way since it first started?

...Not really. No.

It's... it's pretty much the same. Just... what they're doing. It hasn't changed.
